description: This file defines a confirmation dialog component and related functions for user interactions such as delete confirmations, logout, and software update notices within the Notesnook project. It includes UI components, dialog management, and utility functions for handling user confirmations.

classes.name: ConfirmDialog
classes.description: A dialog component for user confirmations with customizable checks, inputs, messages, and buttons.

methods.name: showMultiDeleteConfirmation
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for deleting multiple items, with message about moving to trash.

methods.name: showMultiPermanentDeleteConfirmation
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for permanently deleting multiple items.

methods.name: showLogoutConfirmation
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for user logout, warning about unsynced changes.

methods.name: showClearSessionsConfirmation
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for logging out from all other devices.

methods.name: showUpdateAvailableNotice
methods.description: Displays a dialog notifying the user of a new software version and offering to update.
